# Future public release

The repository is staged privately. Changing visibility is a separate maintainer
action; no script or workflow makes it public.

Before doing so, review the final history, author metadata, screenshots and
assets for credentials or private operational details; rerun scripts/check_release.py
and the CPU CI checks. Confirm that all project-owned code can be released under
Apache-2.0 and that upstream notices/model terms remain intact. The TU Braunschweig and IfN marks are included for this private release at the
maintainer’s request. Confirm separate public redistribution permission before
changing visibility; the code license does not grant trademark rights. Keep
private deployment records, raw recordings and model artifacts out of Git.
Review current dependency advisories and keep limitations visible.

Repository description:
Real-time speech dialogue demo comparing a modular VAD → STT → LLM → TTS pipeline with full-duplex Moshi.

Suggested GitHub topics:
speech-to-speech, voice-ai, moshi, full-duplex, speech-recognition,
text-to-speech, realtime, demo

A social-preview PNG is supplied at .github/social-preview.png. It can be selected
in GitHub's repository settings; it combines project artwork with the supplied institutional marks. Keep the
GitHub repository private until the maintainers explicitly choose otherwise.
